steps.command: ls -la /app && which qemu-system-x86_64 qemu-img sshpass expect 2>/dev/null; uname -a
cat /app/opencode.json; qemu-img info /app/alpine-disk.qcow2; ls -la /dev/kvm 2>/dev/null || echo "no kvm"; ip link show | head -20
file /app/alpine.iso; command -v xorriso isoinfo 7z python3 socat nc; ls /usr/share/qemu 2>/dev/null | head

cd /app && timeout 75 qemu-system-x86_64 -m 1024 -smp 2 -accel tcg,thread=multi -nographic -boot d -cdrom /app/alpine.iso -hda /app/alpine-disk.qcow2 -netdev user,id=net0,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:2222-:22 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=net0 -no-reboot </dev/null > /tmp/boot_test.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; wc -c /tmp/boot_test.log

find / -xdev \( -iname '*openssh*' -o -iname '*dropbear*' -o -iname '*.apk' \) 2>/dev/null | head -50; ls -la /var/cache 2>/dev/null; command -v sshd ssh gcc cc make musl-gcc; ls /usr/sbin/sshd 2>/dev/null

for i in $(seq 1 30); do python3 - <<'EOF'
import socket,sys
s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(2)
try:
    s.connect(("127.0.0.1",2222)); print("PORT_OPEN"); sys.exit(0)
except Exception: sys.exit(1)
finally: s.close()
EOF
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then break; fi; sleep 5; done; echo "poll done"; tail -20 /tmp/run_alpine.out 2>/dev/null; echo '---console tail---'; tail -30 /tmp/alpine-console.log 2>/dev/null | cat -v

for i in $(seq 1 40); do if grep -q 'SETUP COMPLETE' /tmp/run_alpine.out 2>/dev/null; then echo COMPLETE; break; fi; if grep -q 'TIMEOUT' /tmp/run_alpine.out 2>/dev/null; then echo TIMEOUT; break; fi; sleep 5; done; echo '---run out tail---'; tail -40 /tmp/run_alpine.out; echo '---console tail---'; tail -60 /tmp/alpine-console.log | cat -v
